stem:
In the figure, PQ and RS are intersecting straight lines.

[Image: Intersecting lines PQ and RS]

What is the value of x + y ?
figure_description: Two straight lines intersect. Line PQ slopes downward from upper-left (point P) to lower-right (point Q). Line RS slopes upward from lower-left (point R) to upper-right (point S). At the intersection, an angle arc indicates the obtuse top angle between ray P and ray S, labeled 150°. An arc indicates the acute angle on the left between ray P and ray R, labeled x°. An arc indicates the acute angle on the right between ray S and ray Q, labeled y°.
